summary: Phase 1 Foundation plan covers 38 files (~2,200 lines) across 9 tasks: Poetry project setup with pyproject.toml, 7 Pydantic v2 data models (company, document, financial with ~80 line items across IS/BS/CF/PerShare, KPIMetrics with 26-ratio calculate() classmethod, memo with 13 sections, research with SWOT/comps/industry trends, job tracking), config loader with pydantic-settings, CompanyPaths storage class, 4 utility modules ported from v1 (pdf scoring, json_fix, currency, logging), Typer CLI with list and status commands using Rich tables, .env.example/.gitignore, and full test infrastructure with conftest fixtures and 3 unit test modules (models, KPI calculations, json_fix).
keyDecisions: Pydantic v2 BaseModel replaces all dataclasses -- automatic validation, serialization, schema generation eliminate manual to_dict() boilerplate

Nested financial models (FinancialPeriod containing IncomeStatement/BalanceSheet/CashFlow/PerShareData) replace flat FinancialMetric rows -- enables type-safe access and maps directly to Excel sheet structure
JSON storage replaces CSV for financials -- Pydantic models serialize naturally to JSON and preserve nested structures
CompanyPaths class replaces module-level path functions -- uses pathlib.Path, instantiable with custom data roots for testing
Explicit CompanyType enum (us_traded/tase_traded/private) in YAML config replaces implicit inference from dual_listed + us_ticker
KPIMetrics.calculate() classmethod expanded from 6 ratios (v1) to 26 across 7 categories (margins, growth, profitability, leverage, liquidity, working capital, valuation)
Typer CLI with Rich tables replaces argparse -- provides type hints, auto-generated help, and finance entry point via pyproject.toml
pydantic-settings for environment variables replaces scattered os.getenv() calls
companies.yaml migration adds company_type field to all 18 existing companies; providers.yaml gains a routing table section
Test fixtures in conftest.py provide sample_company, sample_financial_period, and prior_financial_period for consistent test data across all unit test modules
